steps.content: You win! You seize the chance to rush over and restrain her gun-holding hand.
You must stop her. You won't let her hurt them.

steps.speaker: (Transition)
steps.content: Bang!
You hear a gunshot from under the water. You stand still, stunned, as if all strength is drained from you suddenly.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: You're already dead. It's over, your connection to them has been severed eternally. However strong your power is, however stubborn your longing is, you can't change anything now.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: Can you understand it now?

The water level keeps rising and slowly covers your head. Countless black hands drag you to the bottom of the river. You don't struggle. You don't feel anything. You simply watch her point her gun at you at last.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: True death is powerlessness.

steps.speaker: [Flash, shattering noise]
steps.content: [Flash, shattering noise]
A crisp shattering noise pierces through the chaos. Your eyes snap open, and your lost senses suddenly return to you. After a dazed moment, you recognize the faces before you.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hmm? Are you finally awake? I was gonna give you a punch on the head.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, did you find the answer? Mmph!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ehh, waa, ahhh! Why are you hugging me? Let go, let go, let go!
You hug the two of them instinctively and keep making sure that they're indeed alive, that they're real, before you let go.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Are you okay? Did you have a nightmare?
The two of them stoop before you, unharmed and calm, as if everything you saw just now was nothing more than a bad dream.

And the only person next to you in the dream is now watching you with a smile, the familiar warm smile you're used to. But now, that smile gives you a chill. You prop yourself up to put the two behind you.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: Hehe, I fulfilled your request and accepted your shackles. Why should you still be worried?

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: You've glimpsed death and been in touch with that world. Are you satisfied with what you've gained?
You hesitate and unleash the shackles warily...
You indeed sense a hint of Mania in the air. Unlike Parma's contamination, it smells faintly like... death. It points vaguely to somewhere above, the high levels of the Drifter Camp.

It's a glimmer of hope. In the past, you would do whatever you could to catch it. But right now, you're out of strength, as if your consciousness is still being crushed by that excruciating powerless feeling.

steps.speaker: Options
options: You created those illusions, didn't you?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm grateful for your help, but why did you show me those horrifying scenes?

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: Consider it a small piece of advice.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: You're someone who dares to frequent the realm of death just to achieve your goal, yet you're completely ignorant about death. It helps to have experienced it once yourself, lest you forget.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: Death isn't only pain and sacrifice, it's a sheer end and farewell. From then on, you're devoid of power, and you cannot look back. Think it through, how much you're willing to sacrifice in exchange for the resolve to die.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: It must be so hard for you, no? Poor thing... Doomed to walk with death, but so full of yearning.
There's a flicker of sadness in her smile.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: I wish when you finally return to me, pain and regret won't be the only things I'll hear from you.

steps.speaker: (Scene change)
steps.content: Sound of communication connecting

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: ...So this is her answer?

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: I understand now. The FAC can't possibly control the other half-body of the Corpus. It's buried deep in the <color=#fb9259>dark pit of DisSea</color>. They can't endure that kind of contamination.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Then, can you locate that monster with this obscure tracking ability?

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: ...I see. How long will it take?

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Is that so...

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: I haven't given up. I only need to confirm one last thing with you.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: If you can't destroy the demi-Corpus in the Inner Bay, if Rustfire's evacuation operation fails, if you can't find the monster in the Drifter Camp in time... If the Black Ring erupts eventually...

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Can you kill it thoroughly? Just like how you destroyed BR-004.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: ...Okay, good, that's enough. No matter what, please put an end to this.
